purpose: Validate S0 with valid paired radio input and actual NeuralRx on one MPS GPU
hardware: one A100-SXM4-40GB, MIG disabled, one MPS server, same physical GPU
ran_workload: Aerial PdschTx-generated 273-PRB slot decoded through CE, NI, EQ, de-rate-match, LDPC, CRC, and payload comparison
ai_workload: Aerial NeuralRx TensorRT FP16 CUDA Graph
selection_history: An exploratory 1000-request paired-radio run missed an 8 ms deadline once with a maximum of 8.789 ms; 9 ms is evaluated only on new seeds.
interpretation_limit: Repeated decoding uses a fixed valid slot per run; channel diversity and unconditional hard-real-time proof remain future work.
